name: connexion-ide
description: This is a [Next.js](https://nextjs.org) project bootstrapped with [`create-next-app`](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/cli/create-next-app).

scripts.build:server: npm run check:mojibake && pkg . --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node22-macos-x64 --output native/dist-macos-x64/zaalis-server
scripts.build:cli: npm run check:mojibake && pkg cli.js --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node22-macos-x64 --output native/dist-macos-x64/bin/zaalis
scripts.build:server:arm64: npm run check:mojibake && pkg . --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node22-macos-arm64 --output native/dist-macos-arm64/zaalis-server
scripts.build:cli:arm64: npm run check:mojibake && pkg cli.js --no-bytecode --public --public-packages "*" --targets node22-macos-arm64 --output native/dist-macos-arm64/bin/zaalis
